log.reply:
Dear Dana Whitfield,

**Situation Summary**

Tamarack Instruments designs and manufactures laboratory measurement instruments and operates in the Netherlands, Germany and the United States. Its AI use cases are:

- **Deployed:** a customer service chatbot on the support portal.
- **Piloting:** AI visual inspection on the German production line.
- **Planned:** AI sales forecasting next year.

AI maturity is recorded as Piloting. The stated objective is: "I want governance in place before visual inspection goes into production in Q2 2027." Two constraints are stated: customer data must stay in the EU, and the German works council is consulted before anything touches production staff. The decision timeline is not yet known.

**What the Briefing Covers for the Client**

The Executive Briefing will map the EU AI Act and GDPR to each use case. These are expectations to verify with counsel, not legal advice.

For the chatbot, the session will examine transparency expectations toward people interacting with an AI system. Where personal data is processed, it will also cover GDPR obligations alongside the EU data residency constraint.

For visual inspection, the session will frame whether the system could fall within an EU AI Act risk category. The answer shapes the governance work needed before Q2 2027.

For sales forecasting, the session will set governance expectations before build begins. United States requirements appear only as a general landscape item because none is listed as a driver.

The governance operating model will be outlined using the GRC Workbook (https://github.com/rolldabones/grc-workbook) and Slow AI Kitchen (https://github.com/rolldabones/slow-ai-kitchen). AI Governance for Boards (https://github.com/rolldabones/ai-governance-for-boards) serves as the board-layer reference. The session applies three principles: Slow AI, Informed Intent, Final Liability rests with the Human.

ISO/IEC 42001 preparation will be discussed as readiness context. The Briefing does not promise certification, audit outcomes or regulatory approval. Content is prepared for the listed audience roles: General Counsel, CISO, Head of Quality, Head of Data, German plant manager and two internal auditors.

**Logistics and Price**

The Briefing is two hours, live virtual, at US$3,000. The session date is Unknown and will be agreed with the Client.

**What the Client Receives Afterward**

A post-briefing summary memo recording decisions surfaced and readiness observations. It also gives three prioritized recommendations, each mapped to a next program option.

**Next Step**

We propose a short intake call to confirm the following:

- The session date.
- Whether personal data flows through the chatbot.
- How visual inspection output is used in production decisions.
- The ISO/IEC 42001 start date, which is not yet fixed.

Kind regards,

Senior AI Governance Consultant
AI Governance Academy

Human-made, for Easy Work, Simply Done.
